bioCard.title: Web Developer, UI/UX & WordPress Developer
paragraphs: Software Engineering graduate with professional experience in web development, UI/UX design, and educational technology. Experienced in developing institutional websites and web-based systems using Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and MySQL.

Also experienced in UI/UX prototyping in Figma, WordPress development, and mentoring students in programming and software projects. Passionate about building user-friendly, scalable, and impactful digital solutions.

timelineItems.title: Laboratory Instructor
timelineItems.description: Developed & maintained 3 institutional websites (SMA, SMK, Polytechnic) using Laravel, Tailwind CSS, and Next.js. Built OrensPro extracurricular attendance system with QR Code & GPS verification, managed hosting/domains/email systems, and mentored PPLG students.

timelineItems.title: UI/UX Designer
timelineItems.description: Designed UI/UX interfaces to improve usability and user experience. Created wireframes, prototypes, and mockups using Figma for the Labsco Arena Teknologi company profile website.

timelineItems.title: WordPress Developer
timelineItems.description: Developed a responsive company profile and retail website using WordPress and Elementor. Set up hosting environment for optimal performance & security, and configured company email with scheduled backups.

timelineItems.title: UI/UX & Frontend Developer
timelineItems.description: Designed user-friendly interfaces, wireframes, and prototypes, and collaborated with the team to develop responsive and interactive frontend components using HTML, Bootstrap, CSS, and JavaScript.
